svg.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-seat-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scale; subtitle: The placement seat converts to full-time before two contractor additions.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time; C means contractor. Core pod: owner 1 FT plus placement, property, and billing 3 C. Scaled pod: owner and placement 2 FT plus property, billing, inventory, and coverage 4 C. Each node represents one person when active; the last two nodes activate only in the scaled scenario. Worker classification follows actual working arrangements.; caption: Conservative: $180,000 gross, $81,000 retained, $21,600 profit at 12% gross margin and 26.67% retained margin. Base: $790,000 gross, $355,500 retained, $150,100 profit at 19.0% and 42.22%. Scaled: $1,400,000 gross, $630,000 retained, $364,000 profit at 26% and 57.78%.; stages: label: Owner and commercial lead; value: Core and scaled: one full-time accountable operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own landlord commitments, payer credit terms, pricing floors, cash exposure, and placement exceptions. Review a weekly forward vacancy schedule and aged receivables before accepting additional fixed lease obligations.; label: Placement and extension lead; value: Core: one contractor; scaled: one full-time lead; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own intake, approved budgets, inventory matching, and extension reminders. Reconcile authorized ALE or CRS portal records with Airtable; use supported integrations or permitted exports rather than assuming API access.; label: Property readiness lead; value: Core and scaled: one contracted property-readiness specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own inspections, turnover scheduling, access provisioning, and vendor dispatch. Use smart locks plus disclosed leak and noise-level telemetry; avoid recording private conversations or using cameras inside occupied homes.; label: Billing and collections lead; value: Core and scaled: one contracted billing specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own QuickBooks Online invoices, approved utility-cap charges, payment matching, deposit liabilities, and extension billing. Escalate overdue balances before additional unfunded nights accumulate.; label: Inventory onboarding specialist; value: Scaled addition: one contractor for incremental property onboarding; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate only in the six-person configuration. Assemble landlord addenda, property specifications, tax treatment records, readiness photographs, and insurance evidence without shifting final lease authority from the owner.; label: Service coverage specialist; value: Scaled addition: one contractor for extended service coverage; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate only in the six-person configuration. Provide documented incident triage and extension follow-up coverage; route emergencies to appropriate responders and log handoffs to the property lead.
